Peg: Fixed at 1 LND = 750 USD, ensuring parity with U.S. dollar stability while providing expanded restitutionary value. Issuance: Through SoLN Treasury under executive authority, supported by certified Safe Keeping Receipts (SKRs) and trust-backed instruments. Redemption: LND may be exchanged for USD equivalents under restitution settlements, credit union partnerships, and sovereign transactions. 4. Stability vs. Crypto: Unlike volatile digital assets, LND ensures confidence through fiat peg, permanent collateralization, and sovereign guarantees. Use of Funds: Supports land reclamation, population restitution (1.4 trillion allocation claim), and community wealth programs. 5. Technical Infrastructure Ledgering: All LND transactions recorded under sovereign financial reporting aligned with GASB and FASAB standards. Payment Messaging: Conforms with ISO 20022 XML message sets, enabling Fedwire/SWIFT-like compatibility. Currency Coding: Eligible under ISO 4217:2015 user-assigned range (XA-XZ) for non-state sovereign issuers. Auditability: Supported by quarterly restitution invoices, GAO submissions, FinCEN filings, and certified court filings. 6.
